about: Craft checklist, department cartography (P3b, docs/CRAFT_CURRICULUM.md). Same shape as training/video_criteria.json, plus artefact (the field the check reads), source (docs/research/CRAFT_SOURCES_2026-10.md section and verdict, the repository rule, or 'Blueprint 2026-10 (unverified)') and enforced_by (an existing path, a planned validator with its phase in planned, or manual). check = code (a validator measures it), critic (the script-critic or editorial review ticks it), eye (the creator's or Claude's look at the frames), manual (a person does it). Every number is a BP id in sourced_rules.json; nothing here is binding: no row has two verified source types yet. Skill: .claude/skills/cartography/SKILL.md.

criteria.name: an animated map frame stays simple: label and unit caps, inactive terrain dimmed
criteria.source: CRAFT_SOURCES_2026-10 §6 (SUPPORTED): Harrower 2003: frames relatively simple, small details are missed; the caps are NOT FOUND

criteria.name: one change at a time; the changed thing is highlighted before it moves
criteria.source: CRAFT_SOURCES_2026-10 §6 (PARTIAL): Harrower 2003: decay and sequencing; 'one at a time' not explicit

criteria.name: a temporal legend or date chip whenever map time advances
criteria.source: CRAFT_SOURCES_2026-10 §6 (PARTIAL): Harrower 2003: temporal exaggeration; no date-chip rule

criteria.name: labels never cross a line feature, keep one offset and a halo, size by feature class
criteria.source: CRAFT_SOURCES_2026-10 §6 (PARTIAL): Imhof 1975 through secondary summaries; the primary was not opened

criteria.name: quantitative layers use sequential or diverging palettes; faction pairs are colour-blind safe and never colour-only
criteria.source: CRAFT_SOURCES_2026-10 §6 (SUPPORTED): ColorBrewer: sequential, diverging, qualitative, colour-blind-safe filter

criteria.name: one projection and north-up per episode; a scale bar on every meso and micro map; a legend only with more than two symbol classes
criteria.artefact: map plate set of the episode
criteria.source: Blueprint 2026-10 (unverified): no opened source; Brewer and MacEachren not re-opened (CRAFT_SOURCES §6)

criteria.name: a change of map altitude takes its eased duration
map type is the style bible's (Fredoka, Inter), not the Blueprint's set
